title_en: Foot Fish - Hans Christian Andersen Award
full_text_zh:
[P1] 脚鱼
[瑞士] 汉娜·约翰森 文 [德] 罗特芳特·苏珊娜·贝尔纳 图 任庆莉 译

手机淘宝扫一扫

北京联合出版公司
Beijing United Publishing Co.,Ltd.

后浪

1/16

[P3] 很快就要到多多的生日了。
每年都会有这么一天的。今年多多说：
“我过生日什么礼物都不要。”
“什么都不要吗？”妈妈问。
“几乎是吧。”多多说。
“什么叫几乎是？”妈妈问道。
“就要一条脚鱼。”
“你想要一条小鱼？”
“是的，就要一条脚鱼。”

[P4] “好啊，”妈妈说，“你过生日，你可以得到一条小鱼。”
首先要有一个鱼缸。
“这个鱼缸要大，”多多说，“为了我的脚鱼。”
此外，还需要水生植物。
“这些水生植物一定要好看，”多多说，“也是为了我的脚鱼。”
然后她们往鱼缸里倒水。
“水一定要这么重吗？”多多问。

[P5] 第二天就是多多的生日了。
脚鱼已经在鱼缸里了，一条非常漂亮的金鱼，
看上去是红色或蓝色的，因为从不同的位置可以看到不同的颜色。
脚鱼看见多多走向它时，就穿过水生植物游到前面，看着多多。
“你还真像一条鱼。”多多说。
脚鱼摇了摇脑袋，张开嘴，然后又合上。
多多很开心。
“你真漂亮啊！”多多说。
脚鱼再次张开嘴，然后又合上。
“你说什么？”多多问道。
“我说你也很漂亮。”脚鱼说。
好在妈妈听不见脚鱼在说什么，多多心想。
脚鱼在鱼缸里游了一圈。

[P6] 当脚鱼再次游到鱼缸前面的时候，
多多问：“你饿吗？”
“当然饿呀。”脚鱼说。
多多给脚鱼喂了罐子里的鱼食，
脚鱼吃饱后在鱼缸里转着圈游来游去。
妈妈也一直在看着脚鱼，
她跟多多说：“你不觉得它很孤单吗？”
“它有我呀！”多多说。
“当然，它有你，但它是一条鱼啊，你不认为，
它更需要另一条鱼的陪伴吗？”
“不，它不需要其他鱼的陪伴，
它是一条脚鱼，不是小鱼。”
多多一整天就这么站在放鱼缸的柜子前，盯着她的鱼缸看。
水生植物在鱼缸里轻轻摇曳，好像水里有风。
脚鱼在绿色植物中穿游，每当它游到鱼缸的前面，
它就用一只眼睛盯着多多看，张开嘴，然后又合上。
它看上去不仅仅是红色或蓝色，有时还是绿色或黄色，
但是这一定要它愿意的时候。
晚上当多多躺在床上时，
透过门，她能听见大人们的声音。

[P7] 多多打开鱼缸里的灯，
注视着在鱼缸里游来游去的脚鱼。
“你不睡觉吗？”多多轻声问。
“不睡，”脚鱼回答，“脚鱼从来不睡觉。”
“从来不睡？”
“从来不睡。”脚鱼说。
“那第二天你不会累吗？”
“不会。”脚鱼说，“我从来不会累。”
“我也想像你一样：从来不累。”
“没有比这更容易的啦。”脚鱼说。
“怎么能做到呢？”
“嗯，”脚鱼说，“这很难解释。但是做比说容易。
那就是，游水，那样就不会累了。”
多多好像总也看不够，
看起来，游水好像真的是世界上最简单的事。
甚至连鳍也不用动啊，多多心想，假如人也有鳍的话。
脚鱼游了几圈，说：
“你也一起来游吗？”
多多摇了摇头。
“为什么不？”
“我不会游水。”多多说。
“每个人都会的。”脚鱼说。
“可我不会。”多多嘟囔道。
“真的吗？”
“真的。”
“太可惜了。”脚鱼说，“如果我整天站在鱼缸前，
看着鱼缸，那我也会睡着的。”

[P8] “我不是整天站在鱼缸前。”多多说。
“不是吗？”脚鱼说。
“当然不是！”
“你今天就在鱼缸前站了一整天。”
“是的，就今天。通常我是绕圈跑。”多多说。
“绕圈？”脚鱼问。
“对，绕圈。”多多答道。
“那你绕一圈让我看看。”
多多围着桌子跑了几圈。
“绕圈跑看起来很奇怪。”脚鱼说，
“好玩儿吗？”
“好玩儿啊！”
“那我也来试试！”脚鱼说。
“你行吗？”多多问。
“为什么不行？”脚鱼说。
脚鱼从水里爬出来，嗅了嗅。
“空气比较干燥哦。”它说。

[P9] “那你要回到水里吗？
“回去？不！
然后多多开始围着桌子跑起来，脚鱼跟在她的后面。
“你还真行啊。”多多气喘吁吁地说。
“跑慢点！”脚鱼边喘气边说，“我可不能像你跑得那么快。”
多多和脚鱼都在大口地喘气。
在这节骨眼上，门开了。
“多多，你该上床睡觉了！”妈妈说。

[P10] “马上。”多多大喊道。
等门关上后，脚鱼说：
“说真的，多多，你不觉得这么绕圈跑有点无聊吗？”
“不无聊，或者说有点。”
“你是说‘不无聊’，还是‘有点’？”脚鱼问。
“我的意思是，如果到外面去跑会更好玩儿。”多多说，
“是有大树的地方。”
“真的吗？”
“真的。”
“那我们就去外面跑。”
“外面很危险。”多多说，
“我们需要一根绳子。”
多多在绳子上打了几个结，
她和脚鱼抓住绳子，
然后开始跑。

[P11] “跑步是件很棒的事。”
脚鱼喘着粗气说，
“只有一件事比跑步更棒。”
“什么事？”
脚鱼笑了，
它移开了目光，
轻声地说：“游泳！”
它张开了它的鳍，
游了起来。

[P12] 脚鱼游啊，游啊，
它游到桌子底下，
游到桌子周围的每个地方。
“游水看起来也很奇怪，”多多说，
“好玩儿吗？
“当然好玩儿。”
“那我也来试试。”
“你行吗？”脚鱼问。
“为什么不行？”多多说。
多多努力试着像脚鱼一样去游。
“你还真行啊！”脚鱼说。
就在这时，门又一次开了。
“多多，上床睡觉。”这次是爸爸。
“知道啦！”多多大声回答。

[P13] 多多和脚鱼又游了一会儿。
“我从没想过游水会是这么棒的事。”多多轻声说道。
“是吗？”
“是的。”
他们爬到了鱼缸的上面，往鱼缸里看。
水生植物在水中轻轻摇曳，就好像水里有风。
脚鱼说：“水里很危险。”
“我们需要一根绳子。”
脚鱼在绳子上打几个结，他们抓住绳子。

[P14] “游水是一件很棒的事。”多多边喘气边说。
偏偏在这时，门第三次开了。
这次听到的是奶奶的声音。
“最好现在把鱼缸里的灯关了，
否则你们整夜都睡不着。”

[P15] “没关系，”
脚鱼轻声地说，
“我们可以在黑暗中游水。”
full_text_en:
[P1] Footfish
[Switzerland] Hanna Johannsen, text [Germany] Rotraut Susanne Berner, illustrations Ren Qingli, translator

Scan with Taobao app

Beijing United Publishing Co., Ltd.

Post Wave

1/16

[P3] It's almost Dodo's birthday.
There's always a day like this every year. This year, Dodo says:
"I don't want any gifts for my birthday."
"Nothing at all?" Mom asks.
"Almost," Dodo says.
"What do you mean 'almost'?" Mom asks.
"I just want a foot fish."
"You want a little fish?"
"Yes, I just want a foot fish."

[P4] "Alright," Mom said, "you can get a little fish for your birthday." 
First, they needed a fish tank. 
"This tank has to be big," Dodo said, "for my foot-fish." 
Also, they needed aquatic plants. 
"These aquatic plants have to be pretty," Dodo said, "also for my foot-fish." 
Then they poured water into the tank. 
"Does the water have to be so heavy?" Dodo asked.

[P5] The next day was Dodo's birthday.
The foot-fish was already in the fishbowl, a very beautiful goldfish,
looking red or blue depending on the viewing angle.
When the foot-fish saw Dodo approaching, it swam through the aquatic plants to the front, looking at Dodo.
"You really look like a fish," Dodo said.
The foot-fish shook its head, opened its mouth, then closed it again.
Dodo was very happy.
"You're really beautiful!" Dodo said.
The foot-fish opened its mouth again, then closed it.
"What did you say?" Dodo asked.
"I said you're beautiful too," the foot-fish said.
Luckily, Mom couldn't hear what the foot-fish was saying, Dodo thought.
The foot-fish swam around the fishbowl once.

[P6] When the foot-fish swam again to the front of the fishbowl,
Duo Duo asked: "Are you hungry?"
"Of course I'm hungry," the foot-fish said.
Duo Duo fed the foot-fish some food from a can,
and after eating, the foot-fish swam in circles inside the bowl.
Mom had been watching the foot-fish all along,
and she said to Duo Duo: "Don't you think it's lonely?"
"It has me!" Duo Duo said.
"Of course it has you, but it's a fish, don't you think
it needs another fish for company?"
"No, it doesn't need other fish for company,
it's a foot-fish, not a little fish."
Duo Duo stood all day in front of the cabinet holding the fishbowl, staring at it.
The aquatic plants gently swayed in the bowl, as if there was wind in the water.
The foot-fish swam through the green plants, and whenever it swam to the front of the bowl,
it would stare at Duo Duo with one eye, open its mouth, and then close it again.
It looked not only red or blue, sometimes green or yellow too,
but only when it wanted to.
When Duo Duo lay in bed at night,
through the door, she could hear the voices of the adults.

[P7] Duo Duo turned on the light in the fishbowl,
watching the foot-fish swim back and forth.
"Don't you sleep?" Duo Duo asked softly.
"No, I don't," the foot-fish replied, "foot-fish never sleep."
"Never sleep?"
"Never sleep," the foot-fish said.
"Won't you be tired the next day?"
"No," the foot-fish said, "I never get tired."
"I wish I could be like you: never tired."
"Nothing is easier than this," the foot-fish said.
"How can you do it?"
"Well," the foot-fish said, "it's hard to explain. But doing it is easier than talking about it.
That is, swimming—then you won't get tired."
Duo Duo seemed to never get enough to look at,
swimming seemed to be the easiest thing in the world.
Even the fins don't need to move, Duo Duo thought, if only humans had fins.
The foot-fish swam a few circles and said:
"Would you like to swim with me?"
Duo Duo shook her head.
"Why not?"
"I can't swim," Duo Duo said.
"Everyone can," the foot-fish said.
"But I can't," Duo Duo mumbled.
"Really?"
"Really."
"What a pity," the foot-fish said, "if I stood in front of the fishbowl all day,
watching the fishbowl, I would fall asleep too."

[P8] "I'm not standing in front of the fishbowl all day," said Duo Duo.
"Are you not?" said the foot-fish.
"Of course not!"
"You've been standing in front of the fishbowl all day today."
"Yes, just today. Usually I run in circles," said Duo Duo.
"Running in circles?" asked the foot-fish.
"Yes, running in circles," answered Duo Duo.
"Then run a circle so I can see."
Duo Duo ran around the table a few times.
"Running in circles looks strange," said the foot-fish,
"Is it fun?"
"It's fun!"
"Then I'll try it too!" said the foot-fish.
"Can you do it?" asked Duo Duo.
"Why not?" said the foot-fish.
The foot-fish climbed out of the water and sniffed.
"The air is quite dry," it said.

[P9] "Do you want to go back into the water?"
"Back? No!"
Then Duoduo started running around the table, with the foot-fish following behind.
"You're really something," Duoduo panted.
"Slow down!" the foot-fish panted, "I can't run as fast as you."
Duoduo and the foot-fish were both panting heavily.
Just then, the door opened.
"Duoduo, it's time for bed!" said Mom.

[P10] "Right away," Dodo shouted.
After the door closed, the fish said:
"Seriously, Dodo, don't you think running in circles is a bit boring?"
"Not boring, or maybe a little."
"You mean 'not boring,' or 'a little'?" the fish asked.
"What I mean is, it would be more fun to run outside," Dodo said,
"somewhere with big trees."
"Really?"
"Really."
"Then let's go run outside."
"It's dangerous outside," Dodo said,
"We need a rope."
Dodo tied a few knots in the rope,
she and the fish grabbed the rope,
and then they started running.

[P11] "Running is a great thing."
Jiao Yu panted, saying,
"Only one thing is better than running."
"What is it?"
Jiao Yu smiled,
it turned away,
whispering: "Swimming!"
It spread its fins,
and began to swim.

[P12] The fish swam, swam, swam,
It swam under the table,
Swam to every place around the table.
"Swimming looks strange too," said Duo Duo,
"Is it fun?"
"Of course it's fun."
"Then I'll try it too."
"Can you do it?" asked the fish.
"Why not?" said Duo Duo.
Duo Duo tried hard to swim like the fish.
"You're really doing it!" said the fish.
Just then, the door opened again.
"Duo Duo, go to bed," said Dad this time.
"Got it!" Duo Duo answered loudly.

[P13] Duo Duo and Jiao Yu swam for a while longer.
"I never thought swimming could be such a wonderful thing," Duo Duo whispered.
"Really?"
"Yes."
They climbed to the top of the fishbowl and looked inside.
The aquatic plants swayed gently in the water, as if there were wind underwater.
Jiao Yu said, "It's dangerous in the water."
"We need a rope."
Jiao Yu tied a few knots in the rope, and they grabbed hold of it.

[P14] "Swimming is a wonderful thing," Duoduo said, panting.
Just then, the door opened for the third time.
This time, it was Grandma's voice.
"It's best to turn off the light in the fish tank now,
or you won't be able to sleep all night."

[P15] "It's okay," 
the fish said softly, 
"We can swim in the dark."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《脚鱼》的封面页，显示了书名、作者、译者、出版社信息以及一个彩色的球形插图。
[P2] 本页为绘本《脚鱼》的第2页，画面分为左右两个场景。左侧是一个充满玩具和家具的儿童房间，一个小女孩站在床上举着写有数字“3”的纸片；右侧是另一个房间，一位女士躺在床上看书，一位老人坐在椅子上看电视，中间有一个人正推着门进入房间。画面中还有企鹅、猫、西瓜等元素，整体呈现家庭生活的日常片段。
[P3] 本页描绘了小女孩多多和妈妈的对话，多多表示自己生日几乎不要礼物，只想要一条“脚鱼”，妈妈对此感到疑惑。画面中，多多牵着一只滑板企鹅，妈妈躺在沙发上看书，旁边有一只翻滚的猫。
[P4] 本页描绘了小女孩多多和妈妈为准备“脚鱼”而布置鱼缸的过程，包括搬运鱼缸、添加水生植物和倒水，多多对水的重量表示疑问。
[P5] 多多生日当天，她收到了心心念念的“脚鱼”——一条会变色的金鱼。多多和脚鱼互相赞美对方，脚鱼虽然无法被妈妈听见，但和多多有了第一次对话。
[P6] 多多喂脚鱼吃食，妈妈担心脚鱼孤单，建议再养一条鱼，但多多坚持认为脚鱼不需要同伴。晚上，多多躺在床上，能听见大人们的声音。
[P7] 多多在夜晚打开鱼缸灯，与脚鱼展开对话，询问其是否睡觉和是否会累，脚鱼解释游水不会累，并邀请多多一起游，多多因不会游泳而拒绝，脚鱼感叹如果自己能整天站在鱼缸前也会睡着。
[P8] 多多与脚鱼对话，解释自己通常绕圈跑，脚鱼对此感到好奇并尝试模仿，但因空气干燥而放弃。
[P9] 多多和脚鱼在房间里围着桌子跑步，脚鱼因跟不上而喘气，妈妈此时进来催促多多上床睡觉。
[P10] 多多和脚鱼讨论绕圈跑是否无聊，决定去外面跑，但因担心危险而需要绳子，于是两人用绳子连接后开始跑步。
[P11] 多多和脚鱼在跑步后，脚鱼表示游泳比跑步更棒，并张开鳍游了起来。
[P12] 多多模仿脚鱼在桌子周围‘游泳’，脚鱼称赞她，这时爸爸进来催她睡觉，多多答应后仍继续玩耍。
[P13] 多多和脚鱼在鱼缸边玩耍，多多感叹游泳很棒，脚鱼提醒水里危险，于是他们用绳子连接，准备探索鱼缸内部。
[P14] 多多和脚鱼在鱼缸里‘游泳’玩耍，多多感叹游泳很棒，这时奶奶第三次进来，提醒他们关灯以免整夜睡不着。
[P15] 脚鱼安慰多多，表示即使关灯也没关系，他们可以在黑暗中继续游泳玩耍。
